summary: The old harness accepts input-controlled parser flags and Markdown bytes, suggesting a route to spoiler spans. The supplied evidence does not show the complete call path to spoiler analysis, so reachability remains unknown.
missing_information: The call path from md_parse through md_process_doc to md_analyze_inlines and spoiler delimiter resolution is not supplied.
requested_symbols: src/md4c.c call sites of md_analyze_inlines and md_analyze_link_contents

claims.necessity_reason: The harness can supply the spoiler flag and ||text|| bytes, but the omitted call path prevents an end-to-end reachability finding for this frozen obligation.

before.requirement: Recognize and render a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set.
before.reason: The complete before span enum has no spoiler type, and the before collector treats pipes as table or wiki-link marks.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before collector creates only single-pipe marks in its pipe handler.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS set, recognize ||text|| and emit x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag, delimiter handling, span callbacks and HTML tags are supplied. The omitted analysis caller path is decisive for establishing that the harness input reaches them.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the flag that enables spoiler spans.
Collects double-pipe marks when the spoiler flag is set.
Analyzes double-pipe marks within link contents.
Turns resolved double-pipe marks into spoiler span callbacks.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles the harness and links the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

claims.comparison_reason: The spoiler contract did not exist before the change. Afterward, the old harness supplies the required flag and bytes, but the supplied source does not establish their complete route to spoiler resolution.
missing_information: Complete before and after md_analyze_inlines bodies and the relevant md_process_doc caller path in src/md4c.c.
